models.architecture_or_algorithm: deep learning model with PC6 encoding (physicochemical component 6); final trained model used for web server
models.input_features: PC6 encoding: six physicochemical properties (hydrophobicity, volume of side chains, polarity, pH at isoelectric point, pKa, net charge index)
models.candidate_reason: Novel AMP predictor with deep learning and PC6 encoding; outperformed existing methods on external test; web server available; code released

models.model_name: Sparse Neural Network Models of Antimicrobial Peptide-Activity Relationships
models.architecture_or_algorithm: adaptive neural network with evolutionary algorithm for sparse connectivity; number of hidden layers, neurons and connections are optimized
models.candidate_reason: Model directly predicts AMP activity; includes experimental validation.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: ensemble random projection (RP) model using proportionalized split amino acid composition (PSAAC) and conventional sequence features
models.input_features: proportionalized split amino acid composition (PSAAC) capturing N-terminal, C-terminal, and middle fragment patterns; plus conventional sequence-based features
models.candidate_reason: Novel ensemble ML model for AMP prediction; outperforms existing methods; Python package available

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Deep learning NLP models combined with QSAR empirical screening
models.candidate_reason: Novel AMP prediction model using deep learning for antifungal peptide screening

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Ensemble Voting of four MLPClassifier models with soft voting; features: AAC and PseAAC
models.input_features: AAC (20 amino acid frequencies) and PseAAC (dipeptide fragment frequencies)
models.candidate_reason: Model appears to be an AMP predictor; information truncated in evidence

datasets.dataset_source: Consolidation of unique AMP sequences from leguminous seeds

important_evidence: AI4AMP: fulltext evidence confirms code repository (https://github.com/LinTzuTang/AI4AMP_predictor), web server (http://symbiosis.iis.sinica.edu.tw/PC_6/), and training on 13,246 peptide sequences; outperformed existing methods.
SAMP: fulltext confirms code repository (https://github.com/wan-mlab/SAMP); outperforms iAMPpred and AMPScanner V2.
Sparse NN model: abstract reports prospective synthesis and testing of 10 de novo peptides; two showed bacteriostatic effects.
DL-QSARES: abstract describes deep learning + QSAR approach for antifungal peptides; no code or web server available.
E-CLEAP: information truncated; appears to be an ensemble ML AMP predictor, but source paper and code unknown.
LysePred predicts hemolytic activity, not AMP prediction; excluded from benchmark models.
uncertainties: AI4AMP has two DOIs (10.1109/bibm.2016.7822515 and 10.1128/msystems.00299-21) and inconsistent metadata; likely a preprint/journal version mismatch.
Fulltext for PMID 34783578 (BIBM 2016) may be incorrect; the correct fulltext is PMC8594441 (mSystems 2021).
Unifying antimicrobial peptide datasets (PMID 39281014) title/journal mismatch; may be a dataset description rather than a review.
Sparse neural network model (PMID 27870247) fulltext was a review chapter, not original research article.

E-CLEAP source paper and DOI remain unknown due to truncated chunk; record_keys include doi:10 1371 journal pone 0300125, doi:10 1002 mbo3 1393, pmcid:pmc13267055, doi:10 2147 aabc s484321 but no titles or models associated.
No web server URL found for AI4AMP in fulltext; only pre-print URL (http://symbiosis.iis.sinica.edu.tw/PC_6/) is available.
BAGEL4 is a tool, not an AMP prediction model; used in a dataset paper (PMID 41148698).
